title: Affirming a Child’s Sex Is Not Abuse
snippet: The Issue Institutions designed to protect children from abuse face growing scrutiny as disturbing stories emerge of parents who have lost custody of their children to the state because they refused to treat a gender-confused child as the opposite sex.
